net/unix#

Exact filesystem address for the current host.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let address=UnixAddress(Path("run/service.sock"));
address.string(); // "run/service.sock"

Description#

Exact filesystem address for the current host. UTF-8 byte length (including room for a terminating NUL) is checked before sockaddr packing. No socket or filesystem I/O, normalization, existence check or absolute conversion occurs. Relative paths remain relative; PathStyle never translates their text here. Named filesystem addresses only: abstract and unnamed addresses are separate.
